hero.title: Projects that deliver. Organizations that evolve.
hero.subtitle: I set up project offices, lead complex deliveries, and develop project managers ready for the real world.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Tailored solutions for each stage of your organization's project management maturity.

s1.title: PMO Setup & Structuring
s1.description: I build and organize project offices from scratch. From diagnosis to operation, I create methodologies, rituals, artifacts, and governance aligned with your company's context and culture.

s2.title: PMO & Project Management
s2.description: I take over the management of strategic projects as a dedicated PMO or PM. I deliver structure, visibility, and results — without you needing to build an internal team from scratch.

s3.title: PM Development
s3.description: For those who already know the theory and need real practice. Workshops and mentoring focused on everyday situations: tough conversations, decisions under pressure, team leadership, and political navigation.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm Renato Decker, a project manager with over a decade of experience in complex, multicultural, and high-pressure environments.
about.p2: I have worked with strategic PMO, digital transformation projects, mergers, and international expansion. My approach combines methodological rigor with pragmatism: what matters is the result, not the certificate on the wall.
about.p3: I believe project management is, above all, about people. Methodology is a tool, not an end.
